description: Ex-9 Squadron Royal Jordanian Air Force F-104A on the Mu'tah University campus at Al Karak, carrying no markings. Construction number 183-1077, ex USAF 56-789. Both spottingmode and the International F-104 Society agree on the identity and the site. The most recent Esri imagery for the point is 27 May 2020, so presence has not been reconfirmed since.
